title: 第25章 降头师这么拉胯吗在线等挺急的第26章 这年头不会八国语言都不配放狠话
content_zh:
那个骑在幽冥战马上的鬼影，转动了一下他那模糊的头颅，发出沉闷的摩擦声。
“无聊。”
“见你用万魂幡，出来看看有没有架打。”
陈邪脸上的肌肉抽了抽。
好家伙，感情是万魂幡里待腻了，自己跑出来放风了。
这老将是他大师傅炼魂老祖亲手封进万魂幡的，说是送他的保命符。
结果这保命符是个好战分子，一闻到打架的味道就自己蹦出来了。
“阿了个佛……”
旁边的悟德，突然身体一僵，整个人都呆住了。
他的身形晃了晃，没了反应。
陈邪还没来得及问他怎么了，悟德的身上爆开一圈柔和的金光。
那金光在他眉心处汇聚，一个“卍”字佛印浮现。
悟德浑身剧震，猛地回过神来，大口大口地喘着粗气，额头上全是冷汗。
就在刚才，他只是多看了那鬼将一眼。
下一秒，他就发现自己已经不在烂尾楼里了。
眼前是尸山血海，耳边是金戈铁马。
无数穿着残破甲胄的士兵在他身边冲锋、倒下。
那股铁与血的煞气，那股直冲灵魂的杀伐之意，几乎要将他的神魂撕成碎片。
悟德心有余悸，背后已经被汗水湿透。
好险！

差一点点，他就迷失在那片可怕的战场幻境里了！
幸好！幸好师傅出发前，在自己身上留下了一道保命佛印。
师傅说，只要化神境不出，元婴之下，这道佛印就能保他无虞。
起初悟德还觉得师傅有点小题大做，区区元婴境，他自己就能应付。
现在他不怀疑了。
师傅，您是真有远见啊！
“哦？”老将那沉闷的声音再次响起，这一次，带着诧异，“你这朋友倒是不错，竟能如此之快挣脱本将的军魂煞境。”
陈邪扭头见悟德那惨白的脸色，便明白过来。
“你别老盯着他看。”陈邪没好气地对悟德说，“这老家伙活了近千年，杀过的人比你见过的都多，你看他一眼，他就把你拖进他记忆里的战场，没点道行，魂都给你冲散了。”
悟德擦了把冷汗，好半天才缓过劲来。
他凑到陈邪身边，声音压得极低，满是震惊。
“陈邪……这……这位如果我没看错的话……”
“这是鬼将啊！”
在749局的档案里，鬼的等级划分得清清楚楚。
鬼将！
比红衣厉鬼还要高一个等级的存在！
红衣厉鬼顶天了就是个化神境，可鬼将，那是有机会修炼成鬼王的恐怖存在！
那可是能虐杀元婴境修士的恐怖存在！
这小子连这种级别的凶魂都能收服？
悟德看向陈邪的表情，十分复杂。
content_en:
The ghost figure riding on the Netherworld horse turned his blurred head and made a dull friction sound.
"Boring."
"I saw you using the Ten Thousand Souls Banner, so I came out to see if there was any fight."
The muscles on Chen Xie's face twitched.
Good guy, the feeling is that I got tired of staying in Wanhun Banner and ran out to let myself go.
This veteran was sealed into the Ten Thousand Soul Banner by his master, the Soul Refining Ancestor, and said it was a life-saving talisman given to him.
It turns out that this life-saving talisman is a militant and pops out on its own as soon as it smells the smell of a fight.
"A Buddha..."
Wude next to him suddenly stiffened and froze.
His body shook and he became unresponsive.
Before Chen Xie could ask him what was wrong, a soft golden light burst out from Wude's body.
The golden light gathered between his eyebrows, and a Buddha seal with the character "卍" appeared.
Wu De's whole body was shaken, and he suddenly came back to his senses. He was breathing heavily, and his forehead was covered with cold sweat.
Just now, he just glanced at the ghost general one more time.
The next second, he realized that he was no longer in the unfinished building.
In front of you is a mountain of corpses and a sea of ​​blood, and in your ears are gold and iron horses.
Countless soldiers wearing broken armor charged and fell around him.
The evil aura of iron and blood, the murderous intention that rushed straight into his soul, almost tore his soul into pieces.
Wude was still frightened, and his back was soaked with sweat.
What a risk!
He almost got lost in that terrifying battlefield illusion!
fortunately! Fortunately, the master left a life-saving Buddha seal on himself before setting off.
The master said that as long as he does not leave the state of transformation and is under the Nascent Soul, this Buddha's seal can protect him.
At first Wude thought that the master was making a fuss out of a molehill, and he could handle it by himself in the Nascent Soul Realm.
Now he had no doubts.
Master, you are really far-sighted!
"Oh?" The veteran's dull voice sounded again, this time with surprise, "You are a pretty good friend. He was able to break away from the evil spirit of this general so quickly."
Chen Xie turned around and saw Wude's pale face, and understood.
"Don't keep staring at him." Chen Xie said to Wude angrily, "This old guy has lived for nearly a thousand years and has killed more people than you have ever seen. If you look at him, he will drag you into the battlefield in his memory. Without even a hint of Taoism, your soul will be washed away."
Wude wiped away the cold sweat, and it took him a long time to regain his composure.
He came close to Chen Xie, his voice was very low and full of shock.
"Chen Xie...this...if I read this correctly..."
"This is a ghost general!"
In the files of Bureau 749, the levels of ghosts are clearly divided.
Ghost general!
An existence that is one level higher than the red-clothed fierce ghost!
The red-clothed fierce ghost is in the realm of personalization, but the ghost general is a terrifying existence that has the opportunity to cultivate into a ghost king!
That is a terrifying existence that can kill Nascent Soul Realm monks!
Can this kid even subdue a vicious spirit of this level?
Wu De looked at Chen Xie with a very complicated expression.
